title: Issue map: the details card shows who opened each issue
story: I click an issue on the map and the details card now tells me who opened it, right after its GitHub state. The map I save as HTML shows the same thing. If the person's account is gone, it says 'opened by unknown' instead of breaking.

checks.criterion: The app's details card shows 'opened by <login>' right after the GitHub state
checks.steps: Open Maestro on a repository with an open issue opened by octo-dev. Press Alt+M and click that issue's box.
checks.expected: The grey line reads 'Level N · GitHub state: OPEN · opened by octo-dev · assigned to …' or '· nobody assigned'.

checks.criterion: The exported HTML map's card shows the same text in the same place
checks.steps: In the issue map choose Save HTML, open the file in a browser and click the same box.
checks.expected: The same grey line, with 'opened by octo-dev' right after the GitHub state.

checks.criterion: An issue with no author login shows 'opened by unknown' in both cards
checks.steps: Click an issue whose author account was deleted (GitHub shows it as ghost), in the app and then in the exported map.
